gherkin.scenario: Edit Emily Johnson's address to new city1 and verify the change
given: Emily Johnson exists in the owner database
when: I search for the owner by Last Name "Johnson"
I edit the owner's City to "new city1"
then: The owner's City should be "new city1"
I should see the updated City value displayed

gherkin_acceptance_criteria: The owner's City should be "new city1"
